content: Theia download:plugins reads theiaPluginsDir (default plugins) and theiaPlugins id->URL map from application package.json; supports only the ${targetPlatform} placeholder (resolves to win32-x64/linux-x64/darwin-arm64 etc at download time); --packed keeps id.suffix archives for hashing, default decompresses; theiaPluginsExcludeIds omits extension-pack members; no integrity verification built in.
